description: Architecture baseline — violations must not increase. Known technical debt is allowed to sit in the baseline and must ratchet down over time.
notes: repositoryViolations=222 is legacy debt in pages/components/hooks. Ratcheted 227->222 by ADR-030 Payroll refactor: pages/Payroll.tsx removed 5 direct .from() calls (2x transactions, staff, comanda_items, comandas) and now consumes payoutService through the usePayoutService hook. forbiddenImports and circularImports were ratcheted to 0 by ADR-027: TenantStatus is canonical in domain/tenant/types (src/lib/supabase/tenant re-exports for compatibility), and billing contracts moved to domain/billing/contracts.ts which both implementations depend on. Ratchet: each value may only go down, never up.
